item.title: The Supply FRV comes home for good in October
item.description:
Attention, Helldivers. Super Earth High Command has an update regarding the M-103 Supply FRV: the resupply slinging cousin of our beloved Fast Recon Vehicle, the full-scale production of which was enabled by the bravery of Helldivers during the Census Thunder Campaign, is being made permanently available in October 2026. Helldivers will be able to unlock it with Requisition slips.

Let's unpack how it works…

item.title: Update 1.4.2 is Coming Week of July 27
item.description:
Another update is around the corner for Civilization VII, featuring a handful of improvements and couple major changes all about deepening your diplomatic strategy: 

  • Expanded Peace Deals: You can now offer Gold and Influence in addition to trading Settlements. We've also updated the UI so you can temporarily dismiss a peace offer to survey the map before making your final decision.
